newsitem.title: USA: Dynamics says court sets injunction vs. WHX.
newsitem.headline: Dynamics says court sets injunction vs. WHX.

text.p: Dynamics Corp of America said Tuesday that the United States District Court for the District of Connecticut had issued a preliminary injunction against WHX Corp in connection with its tender offer for up to 649,000 shares of Dynamics stock.

WHX was ordered by the court to make further and complete disclosures on certain issues and to extend the tender offer, which is presently scheduled to expire tonight, for an additional 20 days, Dynamics said.
WHX originally launched a $40-a-share takeover bid for Dynamics but later sweetened the offer to $45 a share.

WHX is seeking to buy up to 649,000 Dynamics shares, which, if added to its current 2.9 percent stake, would give it ownership of 19.9 percent of Dynamics common stock. This would put its ownership just under Dynamics' anti-takeover provision, which kicks in when another party acquires a 20 percent stake.
WHX has said it would eventually seek to buy all Dynamics shares at $45 each.
Dynamics has rejected both offers and has filed a lawsuit against WHX alleging violations of federal securities laws' antifraud provision in connection with its bid.
